parameters.name: Category
parameters.description: The template category, such as TimerTrigger, EventTrigger, AlarmTrigger, or Other.

parameters.name: CreatedBy
parameters.description:
The creator of the template.
- For official templates provided by Alibaba Cloud, the value is **ACS**.
- For templates created by users, you can specify a **UID** or a **username** to filter templates.

parameters.name: CreatedDateAfter
parameters.description:
Filters templates whose creation time is later than or equal to the specified time.

Format: YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ

parameters.name: CreatedDateBefore
parameters.description:
Filters templates whose creation time is earlier than or equal to the specified time.

Format: YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ

parameters.name: HasTrigger
parameters.description: Specifies whether the template has a trigger.

parameters.name: IsExample
parameters.description: Specifies whether the template is an example template.

parameters.name: IsFavorite
parameters.description: Specifies whether the template is added to favorites.

parameters.name: MaxResults
parameters.description: The number of entries per page. Valid values: 10 to 100. Default value: 50.

parameters.name: NextToken
parameters.description: The token used to retrieve the next page of results. This value is obtained from the response of the current page if more results are available.

parameters.name: SortField
parameters.description:
The field used to sort the query results. Valid values:

- **TotalExecutionCount** (default): total number of executions
- **Popularity**: popularity
- **TemplateName**: template name
- **CreatedDate**: creation time
- **UpdatedDate**: update time

parameters.name: SortOrder
parameters.description:
The sort order. Valid values:

- **Ascending**: ascending order
- **Descending** (default): descending order

parameters.name: Tags
parameters.description: The tags in key-value pairs. The number of key-value pairs ranges from 1 to 20.

parameters.name: TemplateName
parameters.description: The template name. All templates whose names contain the specified template name are returned.

parameters.name: TemplateType
parameters.description:
The template type. Valid values:
- Automation: automation
- State: configuration inventory
- Package: software package
